label: Organism-label class
description: Class of the run's ENA organism/scientific_name label: not_flagged (metagenome/community term), named_human_host ('Homo sapiens' — routine submitter label, NOT a quality signal), named_nonhuman_host (a non-human animal species, e.g. Mus musculus), named_microbe_or_other (a single named microbe or other non-community organism). Sample-level column = highest-priority class over the sample's runs (nonhuman_host > microbe_or_other > human_host > not_flagged).

label: Non-metagenome organism (strict)
description: Sandpiper rule: organism name names a single specific species (including 'Homo sapiens'); names containing 'metagenome' or community terms (uncultured, environmental sample, enrichment/mixed culture, microbial community, consortium, microbiome) and placeholders (bacterium, unidentified, archaeon, prokaryote, eukaryote, organism, microorganism) are not flagged. Kept for reproducibility; noisy because of the human-host label.

label: Non-metagenome organism (loose)
description: Sandpiper rule: organism name lacks 'metagenome' and any community term; placeholders still count as flagged.

label: Non-metagenome label (curated)
description: True when sp_nonmeta_class in {named_nonhuman_host, named_microbe_or_other} over the sample's runs (v1.2.1; v1.2.0 used the strict rule and was dominated by the 'Homo sapiens' label).

label: Synthetic
description: Organism name contains 'synthetic' or 'simulat', or library_source = SYNTHETIC. Sample level: any run.

label: RNA / non-DNA (strict)
description: library_strategy in {RNA-Seq, miRNA-Seq, FL-cDNA, ssRNA-seq, ncRNA-Seq, RIP-Seq, Ribo-seq, EST} or library_source in {METATRANSCRIPTOMIC, TRANSCRIPTOMIC, TRANSCRIPTOMIC SINGLE CELL}.

label: RNA / non-DNA (loose)
description: As strict, plus library_source in {OTHER, SYNTHETIC}.

label: RNA / non-DNA
description: Any run fires the strict RNA rule.

label: Low complexity
description: Sandpiper low-complexity rule on the profile (few taxa dominate). Expected for Bifidobacterium-/Enterobacterales-dominated neonatal stool; display only, never a triage input.

label: Low depth
description: Root coverage < 2 genome equivalents (sample level: summed over profiled runs). Such samples are excluded from study panels and study medians (v1.2.1).

label: Read-fraction warning
description: Sandpiper reports a warning on the prokaryotic read fraction (sp_spf) for the run.

label: Predicted ecological (host-or-not)
description: Sandpiper's sp_prediction / sp_host_or_not says the community looks environmental rather than host-associated.

label: Low known-species fraction at high depth
description: Known-species fraction low despite adequate depth — novel community or off-target sample; study-level fraction is frac_low_ksf_high_depth_profiled.

label: Runs flagged
description: Fraction of the study's runs with sp_nonmeta_class in {named_nonhuman_host, named_microbe_or_other} or synthetic or RNA (strict). The 'Homo sapiens' label is not counted.

label: Low-complexity fraction
description: Fraction of profiled samples with sp_flag_low_complexity.

label: Low-depth fraction
description: Fraction of profiled samples with sp_low_depth.

label: Auditor attention
description: Hint that a study deserves a human look (reason in sp_auditor_reason); never a verdict.

label: Domain-only (GTDB)
description: Every classification in the condensed GTDB profile stops at domain. Not shipped in this package (all catalog profiles reach phylum or deeper for the run set used).

label: Domain-only (GlobDB)
description: GlobDB-scheme profile flag. UNUSED: the catalog uses GTDB profiles only.

label: Domain-only (both)
description: UNUSED: requires the GlobDB profile, which the catalog does not use.
